product_one_liner.value: Advocate is a commercial-insurance market terminal that benchmarks policy pricing and coverage against market data and automates servicing and analysis for insurance brokers, lenders and servicers, and risk teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as providing commercial insurance benchmarks and servicing automation for commercial insurance professionals.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists plans and per-seat prices, as well as a custom-priced Enterprise plan.

named_customers.notes: The homepage says it is trusted by commercial insurance teams but does not name them; the launch announcement also does not identify customers. No two customer names could be verified.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 74 employees, which falls in the 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: The company About page says it is headquartered in New York City; LinkedIn lists its headquarters in New York, United States.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn and Crunchbase identify 2020 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows a company funding/launch announcement and no engineering or technical posts describing how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The company homepage links to public API Documentation and a Help Center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open job board lists engineering, client solutions, and insurance consultant roles; none has AI, ML, data science, or another qualifying term in its title.

model_provider.notes: The company Security page names Anthropic and OpenAI as AI model providers; the DPA also lists them among subprocessors.

compliance_certs.notes: The Security page claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification. GDPR is not included because it is not a certification.

last_funding.notes: The company announced an $18 million seed round on August 4, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: It announced the seed round on August 4, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists open positions, but none is titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Advocate publicly launched its market benchmarking platform on August 4, 2026, within the six-month window from May 9 through November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company About page does not name its leaders, and no verifiable dated C-level or VP join/departure was found; there is not enough evidence to assert either a change or no change.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable careers/job-board and homepage documentation links do not identify a CRM or sales/marketing system.
